source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
To take the measurement, complete the numbered sequence below.

1) Bend
The person should bend forward at the waist while keeping their arms hanging down and their palms together.

2) Align
The spine must be centered in the middle notch of a phone held horizontally across the upper back.

3) Measure
Move the phone slowly up the spine. As the phone follows the curve, it will tilt sideways; the measured degree is the highest number displayed during this movement.

Reference: <https://video.cedar-meadow.example/watch/e0023>

measurement_sequence.name: Bend
measurement_sequence.instruction: Bend forward at the waist with arms hanging down and palms together.

measurement_sequence.name: Align
measurement_sequence.instruction: Center the spine in the middle notch of a phone held horizontally across the upper back.

measurement_sequence.name: Measure
measurement_sequence.instruction: Move the phone slowly up the spine and use the highest displayed degree as the measurement.

routing_warnings.description: This message identifies video as the iPhone version's How-To media rather than changing the substantive measurement instructions.
The decision to use one shared video for all versions concerns How-To media selection and delivery.
The proposed in-application video embedding concerns media delivery and is only a future implementation commitment.
In context, this client acceptance approves the proposal to stream the How-To video from YouTube.
